item.title: Pelican on a Bicycle in Who Framed Roger Rabbit: Practical Effect Details
item.description:
Pelican on a Bicycle in Who Framed Roger Rabbit: Practical Effect Details

On 18 September 2026 a blog post highlighted a memorable practical‑effects sequence from the 1988 film Who Framed Roger Rabbit.

🎬 Overview

  • The scene features a pelican riding a bicycle.
  • The pelican is animated while the bicycle is a real bicycle.

⚙️ How it was done

  • Wheels were filled with water to add stability.
  • The bike was set running and guided with a cable.

📜 Sources

  • Cypress Frankenfeld pointed out the sequence and gathered details.
  • The blog entry notes “What a delight.”

#WhoFramedRogerRabbit #PracticalEffects #FilmTech
